scientific_integrity: Analytic Dirichlet-form and spectral-theorem proof with numerical and exact one-dimensional checks; numerical examples are not used as infinite-dimensional certification.
scientific_limitations: Requires a bounded C2 spatial domain with complete absorption, uniform independent initial position and heading, strictly positive translational diffusivity, and achiral orientation diffusion.
The new order is Laplace-transform order, not an asserted first-order stochastic ordering, nor pointwise monotonicity for fixed initial states.
The derivation uses established antisymmetric-operator spectral theory; publication priority relative to implicit broader resolvent results remains unconfirmed.
title: All-speed Laplace ordering for uniformly released active Brownian searchers
